exposure: continuous positive airway pressure immediately after birth
timing of initiation of enteral feeding
outcome: alterations in central nervous system ultrasound
cohort: The study included 26 preterm newborns born under 32 weeks of gestational age in a tertiary hospital in Spain in 2011 and 2021.
finding: Significant differences were observed in the management of preterm newborns over 10 years, resulting in lower mortality and less growth retardation during admission in 2021, although these improvements did not manifest in long-term somatometrics or neurological prognosis.
